title: 281 Salt Box Lane | Royal Destinations
meta_description: WaterSound Amenities + Beach Access- 281 Salt Box by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: 281 Salt Box Lane by Royal Destinations Location: WaterSound Beach Address: 281 Salt Box Lane, WaterSound, FL 32461 Details: Located in the Gulf front community of WaterSound Proper, this adorable cottage is a perfect retreat for a family, couples or friend’s getaway. Ideally situated between Seaside and Rosemary Beach, WaterSound is famous for its walking paths and meandering boardwalks located throughout community and Camp Creek Lake, one of the world's few natural coastal dune lakes. The home sleeps 6 and comes with 4 bikes for easy access to the beach and other amenities that WaterSound has to offer. Guests will greatly enjoy being just minutes from the beautiful white sand beaches and sunsets beyond compare. This Hampton/Cape Cod feel community is one of the most sought-after retreats in Florida. Lose yourself in the private coastal experience of WaterSound. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - 4 Adult Bikes Provided - 300 yards to the Gulf - High Speed Wireless Internet - Front porch with Adirondack chairs and swing - Fully equipped kitchen - This property comes with 1 dedicated parking spot. Additional parking can be found throughout the community. - Location: This home is 300 yards from the Gulf. WaterSound Community Highlights: -Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach -(2) Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate) -Kayak Rentals -Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks -Bike to Alys, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach -A short walk to the HUB *Please Note: Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included. WaterSound does not allow golf cart rentals from outside vendors. Home Configuration+ Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 6 3 Beds / 3 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed, Private Bath -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area / Laundry Room / Full Bath -Bathroom w/ Tub Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: (En Suite) King Bed with Private Bath -Bedroom 3: Two Twin Beds Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
